The image-derived pricing was partially obscured and the exact meaning of 'over the limit' could refer to files exceeding the Standard plan's 1TB capacity (approx. 440 files), not merely the remaining uploads. The agent proceeded with assumptions and did not request clarification from the user or the team, leading to an incorrect calculation. This matches FM-2.2: the agent failed to ask for clarification when faced with unclear or incomplete data, acting immediately on ambiguous inputs.
